title: shop: AI models & providers
description: Every model call by provider and model: tokens and calls by day, latency, time to first token, output speed, errors, the cache, and calls a gateway served with another model. From the GenAI spans in the environment's traces, so the range is bounded by their retention.

panels.title: Tokens by model
panels.description: Input and output tokens each UTC day by model: the eight models with the most tokens in the range, the rest as Other.
panels.sql:
WITH calls AS (SELECT Timestamp AS ts, if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model']) AS model, toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']) + toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) AS tok FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings']),
top AS (SELECT model FROM calls GROUP BY model ORDER BY sum(tok) DESC, model LIMIT 8)
SELECT toDate(ts) AS day, if(model IN (SELECT model FROM top), model, 'Other') AS model, sum(tok) AS "Tokens"
FROM calls GROUP BY day, model ORDER BY day, model

panels.title: Calls by model
panels.description: Model calls each UTC day by model: the eight models called most in the range, the rest as Other.
panels.sql:
WITH calls AS (SELECT Timestamp AS ts, if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model']) AS model FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings']),
top AS (SELECT model FROM calls GROUP BY model ORDER BY count() DESC, model LIMIT 8)
SELECT toDate(ts) AS day, if(model IN (SELECT model FROM top), model, 'Other') AS model, count() AS "Calls"
FROM calls GROUP BY day, model ORDER BY day, model

panels.title: Providers and models
panels.description: Calls, failed calls, latency (p50, p95), time to first token of streamed calls (p50; a gen_ai.first_token event), output tokens per second of call time, tokens, the prompt cache hit ratio, and the gateway-reported cost.
panels.sql:
SELECT if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system']) AS "Provider", if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model']) AS "Model", count() AS "Calls",
       round(countIf((StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') AND SpanAttributes['error.type'] != 'canceled')) / count(), 4) AS "Error rate",
       round(quantile(0.5)(Duration / 1e6)) AS "p50 ms", round(quantile(0.95)(Duration / 1e6)) AS "p95 ms",
       round(quantile(0.5)(if(indexOf(Events.Name, 'gen_ai.first_token') = 0, NULL, (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(Events.Timestamp[indexOf(Events.Name, 'gen_ai.first_token')]) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(Timestamp)) / 1e6))) AS "TTFT p50 ms",
       round(sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])) / nullIf(sumIf(Duration, toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) > 0) / 1e9, 0), 1) AS "Output tok/s",
       sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])) AS "Input tokens", sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])) AS "Output tokens",
       round(sum(toUInt64OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read_input_tokens']))) / nullIf(sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])), 0), 4) AS "Cache hit",
       round(sum(toFloat64OrNull(if(SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'] != '', SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'], SpanAttributes['reliant.cost_usd']))), 4) AS "Reported cost (USD)"
FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings']
GROUP BY "Provider", "Model" ORDER BY "Calls" DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Served by another model
panels.description: Calls a provider or gateway answered with a model other than the one asked for (gen_ai.request.model against gen_ai.response.model): a fallback, or an alias resolved to a dated model.
panels.sql:
SELECT SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] AS "Asked for", SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'] AS "Served by", count() AS "Calls"
FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings']
  AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] != '' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'] != '' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] != SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model']
GROUP BY "Asked for", "Served by" ORDER BY "Calls" DESC LIMIT 50
